scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw particle trajectories is not feasible because the agent only reports final aggregated coefficients and energy‑loss histograms; we therefore compare the reported results to paper‑derived gold values with tolerances and a monotonicity check.

outputs.description: Backscattered coefficient as a function of surface electric field Emax for five values: 0, 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8 V/m.
Depth-resolved energy loss distributions for the uncharged (Emax=0) and charged (Emax=1e8 V/m) cases, binned from 0 to 500 nm with 10 nm bins.

output_contract.notes: Hidden reference values are derived from digitized figures in the original paper. Tolerances accommodate Monte Carlo statistical noise and implementation-dependent variations.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold backscattered coefficient values and analytic parameters for depth distributions
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Backscattered coefficient digitized from Fig 1 of the paper; depth distribution parameters derived from the qualitative shapes and reported total deposited energies shown in Fig 2‑4.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Backscattered coefficients were read from the figure; depth distributions are modeled as lognormal curves with peak positions and widths matching the paper, scaled to total energy deposition per electron reported in the text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values faithfully represent the paper’s published results within the resolution of the figures; a correct Monte Carlo simulation will produce numbers close to them within the stated tolerances.
